sentences.text:
Chief Judicial Magistrate vs In Re: Farida Bibi & Anr on 11 July,
2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen

Court No.29
 Item No. 48
 Allowed
 sg
 Crm (A) 2348 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Se
 Criminal Procedure in connection with Kirnahar Police
 2024 dated 04.05.2024 under Sections 498A/323/302/34 
 Code and Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act, pending before 
 Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bolpur, Birbhum.

And
 In Re: Farida Bibi & Anr.
 Petitioners
 Mr. Sujoy Sarkar
 For the Petitio
 Ms. Amita Gaur
 Miss. Nahid Ahmed
 For the State

1.
Claiming parity with the co-accused person, namely, Ajnal Sk.
, the present petitioners who happens to be the married sisters-in-law has prayed for anticipatory bail.
2. The learned Counsel for the State does not object to the fact that the petitioners stand on the same footing as that of the co-accused person.

3. Considering the materials available in the case diary and the fact that the present petitioners are standing on the same footing as that of Ajnal Sk. @ Sanowar Sk. @ Aajnal Sekh, who was granted anticipatory bail by a coordinate Bench on 27th June, 2024 in CRM(A) 1979 of 2024 and also having regard to the fact that the allegation appears to be omnibus in nature, we are of the view that the custodial interrogation of the present petitioners is not necessary.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioners namely, Farida Bibi and Tunu Bibi @ Golchehara Bibi, shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of Arresting Officer and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the petitioners shall cooperate with the investigation.
The petitioners shall appear before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bolpur, Birbhum, in connection with G.R. Case No. 611 of 2024 within two weeks from date.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed..
6. CRM (A) 2348 of 2024 is, thus, disposed of.
7. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
